summary: Implemented PD-06 (Edge conditions) across three files. (1) src/definition/graph.zig: added is_default: bool = false field to GraphEdge struct with updated doc comments; added isValidCelSyntax() private pure helper (balanced parens/brackets, unmatched string delimiter detection, non-empty check — no allocations, no I/O); added validateEdgeConditions() public function implementing all 6 CHK-EC checks exhaustively (CHK-EC-01 EDGE_CONDITION_NOT_ALLOWED, CHK-EC-02 EDGE_DEFAULT_NOT_ALLOWED, CHK-EC-03 EDGE_MISSING_CONDITION, CHK-EC-04 EDGE_DEFAULT_HAS_CONDITION, CHK-EC-05 EDGE_MULTIPLE_DEFAULTS via pre-scan and post-loop, CHK-EC-06 EDGE_INVALID_CEL). Uses nodeIndex() helper for stack-only node lookup with no heap allocation. (2) src/definition/store.zig: added [B3] validateEdgeConditions() call in Store.create() after validateNodeAttributes() using the same violation-storage pattern (self.last_violations = edge_result.violations on failure; allocator.free on success). (3) web/src/types/api.ts: already had is_default?: boolean in GraphEdge interface — no change required. (4) Created tests/unit/graph_edge_conditions_test.zig with 19 test cases covering all CHK-EC checks and edge cases. (5) build.zig: registered graph_edge_conditions_test.zig in the test step. zig build exits 0. zig build test exits 0.
